note: These values are only what was observed when the host was read with scripts/measure-model.js (identical across the reads). They have not been checked or verified against anything NEAR AI publishes. Pinning them means trusting that this is the build you mean to trust; a new NEAR AI build will be refused until its values are added to the lists.
